description: The linked reader's shelves: want to read, reading, finished and did not finish, with ratings, percent read and private notes, and their Shortlist, the books saved to maybe read that are on no shelf yet. Suits "what am I reading", "what's on my to-read list", "what's on my shortlist" and "what have I finished". status filters to one shelf and leaves the Shortlist out. Needs a linked Siftivo account.
